"""Who may post in the community forum."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime


@dataclass
class Member:
    name: str
    is_active: bool
    is_banned: bool
    email_verified: bool
    created_at: datetime
    warnings: int = 0


def can_post(member, now):
    if (
        member.is_active
        and not member.is_banned
        and member.email_verified
        and (now - member.created_at).days >= 7
        and member.warnings < 3
    ):
        return True
    return False


def visible_authors(members, now):
    return sorted(
        member.name
        for member in members
        if (
            member.is_active
            and not member.is_banned
            and member.email_verified
            and (now - member.created_at).days >= 7
            and member.warnings < 3
        )
    )


def posting_summary(members, now):
    allowed = 0
    for member in members:
        if (
            member.is_active
            and not member.is_banned
            and member.email_verified
            and (now - member.created_at).days >= 7
            and member.warnings < 3
        ):
            allowed += 1
    return f"{allowed} of {len(members)} members may post"
